description: This file defines the interface for an HTTP client in C++, including response handling, DNS resolution, and various HTTP methods such as GET, POST, DELETE, and download operations. It also includes utility functions and type definitions related to HTTP communication.

classes.name: HttpClient
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for an HTTP client, including methods for GET, POST, DELETE, and download operations, as well as utility functions.

methods.name: CurlClient
methods.description: Creates a new instance of an HTTP client using libcurl, with optional DNS resolver and debug logging.

methods.name: ServerErrorRetryClient
methods.description: Creates a new HTTP client that retries on server errors, with specified retry attempts and delay.

methods.name: GetToString
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and returns the response as a string.

methods.name: PostToString
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with string data and returns the response as a string.

methods.name: DeleteToString
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request and returns the response as a string.

methods.name: PostToJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with JSON data and returns the response as a JSON object.

methods.name: DownloadToJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and returns the response as a JSON object.

methods.name: DeleteToJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request and returns the response as a JSON object.

methods.name: DownloadToFile
methods.description: Downloads content from a URL and saves it to a specified file.

methods.name: DownloadToCallback
methods.description: Downloads content from a URL and processes it via a callback function, returning the HTTP response status.

methods.name: UrlEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in a URL.
